semiconductor_relevance: High — OHMIYA Ind. specializes in manufacturing equipment for semiconductor assembly and processing, making it a relevant player in the industry.
summary: OHMIYA Ind. is a manufacturer of semiconductor assembly and processing equipment, offering a range of solutions from semi-automatic to fully automatic systems. Their product lineup includes tape mounters, UV irradiation machines, and spin dryers, catering to advanced packaging needs.
capabilities: Semi-automatic tape mounter for wafer mounting
LED UV irradiation machine for curing adhesives
Rotating and revolving spin dryers for wafer processing
Advanced packaging equipment for chiplets and interposers
